info.title: SCDC Community, permissions and channel text — target design
info.description: Community/Messaging Foundation only; all operations not implemented. Product decisions DEC-092–098 confirmed; algorithms/schema/errors are draft review artefacts. No server deletion endpoint in v1.

get.summary: Danh sách cộng đồng đang tham gia
get.description: Selected create/view package: active, nondeleted servers with an active membership of the authenticated actor. Limit 1–50, default 20; descending server ID keyset with an actor/limit-bound protected cursor. One authorized SQL projection per page; no immutable collection snapshot is promised.

200.description: Committed result; target design, endpoint not implemented.

get.x-scdc-retry: GET may retry after refresh; mutation requires retry:false and explicit user action. Create operations keep clientOperationId.

post.description: Selected create/view package: atomically commit server, owner membership, @everyone, operation and outbox before success. Actor comes from validated claims. New create returns 201; manual retry with the same clientOperationId and normalized payload returns 200 for the same authorized resource. Different payload conflicts; no automatic mutation replay.

201.description: New server and initial membership committed; includes Location. Target design, endpoint not implemented.

Location.description: Detail URL of the created server under /api/v1/servers/{serverId}.

200.description: Existing operation replay returns the current authorized detail of the same resource and Location without new writes. Target design, endpoint not implemented.

MemberRoles.description: @everyone is implicit and absent from roleIds.

ReplaceChannelAccessRequest.description: Complete replacement; duplicate or cross-server role/member entries invalid; membershipId must be the current active epoch.

id.description: ID ổn định; server tạo mới dùng UUIDv7 theo DEC-081. ID đã có trong seed/Identity vẫn được nhận nếu là UUID hợp lệ.

clientMessageId.description: UUIDv4, tạo một lần khi người dùng gửi; giữ nguyên khi thử lại (DEC-081).

channelId.description: ID ổn định; server tạo mới dùng UUIDv7 theo DEC-081. ID đã có trong seed/Identity vẫn được nhận nếu là UUID hợp lệ.

contentState.description: Optional for ordinary/legacy messages; mandatory when restored latest edit body is missing (DEC-108). No old content is returned.

ChannelMessage.description: Current message. Deleted: content=null and deletedAt set. Restore unavailable: content=null, deletedAt=null and contentState=unavailable_after_restore. Never return old edited body; actor-author may explicitly edit unavailable message with new body. DEC-104/108.

throughSequence.description: Số nguyên không âm dạng chuỗi; client dùng BigInt hoặc tương đương.

resumeCursor.description: Cursor bảo vệ frontier H; non-null ở latest page hoặc trang cuối catch-up. Chỉ lưu sau merge thành công.

nextCursor.description: Opaque encrypted/authenticated cursor bound to actor/resource/filter/limit; expiry 24 hours is a technical proposal.
